content.comment_body: Hello, After reviewing the settings for <file>, <message text settings>, <message text>, and <ticker timer setting>, I noticed that the "Line by line" parameter defaults to 1,000 ms and appears in gray, making it non-editable. Is this value permanently fixed? Does anyone know if there's a way to modify it? Regards,

The "Line by line" value is non-editable because it is directly linked to the "Character by Character" setting. If you change "Character by Character", the "Line by line" value updates automatically. "Line by line" will always be set to 10 times the "Character by Character" parameter.

analysis.insight_summary: A user is unable to change the 'Line by line' timer setting as it is grayed out in the ticker timer configuration. Another user clarifies that this is by design, as the value depends on the 'Character by Character' timer setting and always remains ten times its value. This exchange highlights that the interface does not clearly indicate which fields are linked or user-editable, potentially causing confusion.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects to manually adjust the 'Line by line' timer value and for the interface to make it clear which settings are fixed and which ones depend on others.
